reviews.body: Thanks for the fix and regression tests. Removing the thrown `InterruptedException` prevents oversized messages (> 32 KiB) from setting the caller thread's interrupt flag while preserving error logging and real `BlockingQueue.put` interruption handling. Verified locally and in CI (unit tests, JaCoCo line coverage, PMD, Checkstyle, and published POM checks all pass; `Sonar analysis` and `zizmor` only fail because repository secrets are unavailable on fork PRs).

### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues remain for the change to reject oversized messages without interrupting the caller. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR This PR fixes oversized-message rejection in the analytics client so it no longer interrupts the caller and prevents subsequent valid events from being queued. **Changes:** - Removes the synthetic `InterruptedException` while retaining logging and rejection of messages above 32 KiB. - Adds regression tests for subsequent valid enqueue attempts and preservation of a real interrupt flag. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `analytics/​src/​test/​java/​com/​rudderstack/​sdk/​java/​analytics/​internal/​RudderAnalyticsClientTest.java` | Adds oversized-message and interrupt-preservation regression tests. | | `analytics/​src/​main/​java/​com/​rudderstack/​sdk/​java/​analytics/​internal/​AnalyticsClient.java` | Rejects oversized messages without throwing an interruption exception. |
Review effort: Balanced
